title: REPRISE Phase 4: strongest minimal configuration, independent confirmation, recurrence intervention
context: Reviewer (2026-09-28): the boundary between a properly re-calibrated label propagation and REPRISE-specific gains is not established on independent data. This phase answers it without touching the used OpenOOD test split.

frozen_method.name: REPRISE v5 (registered 2026-09, test-evaluated)
frozen_method.lp_solver: warm start from the previous batch, 15 sweeps (L0)
frozen_method.score: s0 x prod_views p_t x p_LP

data.tuning: dev1 only (already used selection split): 5 support/calibration draws x 3 orders x {near, far}; the existing TINS scores; MCM from the same CLIP features (softmax over cosines, temperature 1).
data.U1: ImageNet-1K train, 5 new class splits (100 held-out classes each, WordNet sibling rule, seeds 20260929..20260933), disjoint from dev1/dev2 held-out classes and from each other; images never used by REPRISE (dev1/dev2, TINS 16-shot list, R5 draws, sealed OpenOOD/val images excluded by name and sha256). Per split: ID = 20 new images of each of 900 ID classes, OOD = 50 new images of each held-out class; shots = new 16 per class per draw.
data.U2: ImageNet-O (official, 2,000 images) as OOD; ID = 10 new images per ImageNet-1K class; shots of all 1,000 classes.
data.U3: WILD wildlife (5 ID species: buffalo, cheetah, elephant, giraffe, hippo; 5 OOD species: impala, leopard, lion, rhino, wildebeest); duplicate-excluded split of another project of the user, never used by REPRISE. Shots from train/id; ID stream = test/id; OOD stream = 400 per OOD species from test/id-disjoint test/ood.
data.no_test_access: The OpenOOD test and ImageNet val images stay sealed (manifest guard).

features: DINOv2 B/14 and L/14 CLS (the frozen REPRISE transforms), CLIP ViT-B/16 (TINS preprocessing); FP32, TF32 off.

families.raw: standard label propagation u (all nodes from 0, 15 sweeps)
families.cdf: current-graph calibration rank of u (0-start, 15 sweeps; permutation-equivariant solver)
families.cdf_L0: current-graph calibration rank of u, warm start (REPRISE's LP path)
families.z: Phi((u - median_cal) / (1.4826 MAD_cal)) on the current graph (scale correction without ranks)
families.mass: u x N_t / N_s (propagated-mass correction implied by 1^T S = 1^T on regular graphs)
families.rw: random-walk normalised LP (D^-1 W), all nodes from 0
families.sprop: static prototype distance d_all propagated on the same graph (score propagation), current-calibration rank
families.stat_cdf / stat_cdf_L0: static prototype p x cdf / cdf_L0
families.rep_L1 / rep_L0: REPRISE memory p_t x cdf / cdf_L0 (rep_L0 at the reference configuration = frozen REPRISE v5)
families.views: log-scores summed over B/14 and L/14; s0 multiplies (adds in log)

tuning.equal_budget: every family gets the same 27 configurations; REPRISE's entrance and prototypes stay frozen
tuning.rule: per family: minimise the dev1 mean (15 conditions) of the standalone (s0=1) near FPR95 among configurations whose far FPR95 is at most +0.5 points above the family's reference configuration; ties: higher near AUROC, then the reference
tuning.best_minimal: the minimal-set family with the lowest selected dev1 near FPR95 (ties: lower far FPR95)
tuning.weighted_control: log TINS + a x (visual log-score), a in {0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3}: a* chosen on dev1 x TINS with the same rule (reference a=1) for the best minimal family and for tuned REPRISE; frozen REPRISE keeps a=1
tuning.lock: selections are written to selection_lock.json with sha256 before any U1-U3 score is computed

evaluation.U1: 5 splits x draws {0,1,2} x orders {123,124,125} = 45 streams, batch 256, TINS order rule
bases: TINS (pinned upstream, fixed hyper-parameters, run per stream from cached CLIP features)
evaluation.metrics: AUROC and FPR95 (threshold accepting >= 95% of ID, ties accepted), as the LP audit
evaluation.units: U1: paired differences averaged within split over its 9 draw x order conditions -> 5 split values -> t 95% interval (df 4); sensitivity: 15 split x draw values. U2/U3: 5 draw values (orders averaged).
evaluation.pipeline_rerun: every condition re-runs the full adaptive pipeline (no score re-sampling)

primary_endpoints.E1: U1, standalone near FPR95: frozen REPRISE v5 minus the best minimal configuration
primary_endpoints.E2: U1, x TINS near FPR95: frozen REPRISE v5 minus the best minimal configuration with its dev-selected weight a*

decision.upper_CI_below_0: REPRISE-specific components add value beyond the strongest tuned minimal configuration on unused data; REPRISE stays the main method
decision.CI_contains_0: no average added value is shown; the paper is rebuilt around the minimal configuration (calibrated LP) and the memory is reported only where Exp 6 shows condition-specific value
decision.lower_CI_above_0: the minimal configuration is better; same restructuring

secondary: every family vs frozen REPRISE and vs tuned REPRISE on U1-U3 (near FPR95, AUROC; bases none/TINS/MCM)
standard converged LP (L2) at the raw family's selected configuration
U2 and U3 replications of E1/E2

exp4_recurrence_intervention.data: U1 held-out classes: per split 50 probe classes (seeded) and 50 background classes; 250 probe classes in total
exp4_recurrence_intervention.history: per split a fixed 1,024-image history (768 ID from ID-evaluation images not used as queries, 256 OOD from background classes), batches of 256; r in {0,1,2,5,10,20} nested OOD positions replaced

replacement_content.same: other images of the probe class
replacement_content.near: images of the most similar other probe class (L/14 class means)
replacement_content.far: images of the least similar other probe class
replacement_content.dup: r weak augmentations of one probe-class image (near-duplicate retrieval control)

exp4_recurrence_intervention.queries: 8 probe-class images and 128 common ID images per split, each scored alone on a cloned state (then discarded)
methods: static p x p_LP (L0, reference graph)
exp4_recurrence_intervention.estimand: per probe class: [AUROC_REPRISE(same, r=20) - AUROC_REPRISE(same, 0)] - [AUROC_staticxLP(same, 20) - AUROC_staticxLP(same, 0)]; class-bootstrap 95% interval (2,000 resamples) and split-clustered bootstrap
exp4_recurrence_intervention.secondary: same vs near vs far vs dup curves, fraction of classes improved/worsened, first-appearance performance, per-r differences

exp5_7_operating.status: descriptive, after the confirmatory evaluation, on U1; no selection
exp5_7_operating.exp5: batch sizes {1,16,64,256} (the detector sees the same batch rule; TINS rerun with the same batch size); fixed thresholds from dev1 ID scores at nominal false-alarm rates {0.1,1,5}%: realised ID false alarms, OOD detection, images until first detection
exp5_7_operating.exp6: final settings under long ID-only prefix, ID class bursts, 1%/5% OOD, and combinations; erroneous admissions by class, subsequent same-class ID p_t<=0.1 rate, recovery
exp5_7_operating.exp7: history caps {1k, 8k, 32k} x retention {FIFO, random, farthest-point diversity} on long streams; time per component, allocated vs reserved GPU memory

guardrails: no parameter or rule change after U1-U3 are scored; any later analysis is labelled post hoc
a U bank used to change the method afterwards is re-labelled development
all failures and reruns are kept in failures/ and dispatch logs
